flags.why: The slang adjective means immature or childishly attention-seeking, rather than simply tacky or unattractive ([dictionary entry](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/tr%E1%BA%A9u)).

Calling someone trẩu disparages their maturity and behaviour, so learners need a derogatory warning ([usage explanation](https://vietnamnet.vn/dinh-nghia-tre-trau-tinh-tinh-hay-tuoi-tac-ig7784.html)).
